about_the_game:
Step Into the Fast-Paced World of Journalism!

In Reporter Desk, you take on the role of a rising journalist navigating the dynamic and often chaotic world of news reporting. Armed with a typewriter, a phone, and a camera, you must uncover the truth, chase breaking stories, and build your newspaper empire from the ground up.

Answer urgent calls, gather leads, and decide which stories are worth publishing. Will you expose corruption, capture shocking crime scenes, or dive into the city's underground world of gambling and hidden deals? The choice is yours, but every decision shapes your reputation and success.

Key Features:

📰 Immersive Journalism Gameplay – Investigate, write, and publish stories that shape the world around you.

📸 Capture the Action – Use your camera to document key events, from action scenes to city life.



📞 Dynamic Newsroom – Answer calls, follow leads, and manage the daily pressure of reporting.



🏙️ Living, Breathing City – A world filled with basketball courts, shady bars, and bustling cafés, each with its own stories.

💰 Build Your News Empire – Expand your office, hire staff, and increase production to dominate the news industry.

🔍 Your Choices Matter – Will you chase sensational headlines for quick cash or uphold journalistic integrity?

Get ready to experience the highs and lows of investigative journalism in Reporter Desk! Will you be a fearless truth-seeker or a sensationalist chasing the next big headline? The pen—and the camera—are in your hands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3,3 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 @ 3,2 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Become a journalist in a dynamic newsroom where every call is a new lead. Investigate news, capture breaking stories with your camera, and expand your newspaper business in a living, breathing city. Will you chase sensational headlines or uphold journalistic integrity?
